GitHub #560's design (mitcad#2208; opened with --open, never committed; tools/cli/fillet-narrow-face-tangent-reported-test.cmake): Sketch1 (F1) a section whose bottom steps down 2.98 at the origin (a riser, the narrow face) into a half disc of radius 15.46 tangent to the riser; Extrude1 (F2) 25 deep (along -y); Extrude2 (F4) cuts a corner off through the height (z), short of the riser; Fillet2 (F7) rounds the concave edge between the bottom left of the step and the riser with 11.9; Fillet1 (F6), after it, rounds the cut's vertical edge and the end face's left edge with 9. Body1 is 63235.172688 before the fillets, its box x -19.127842..51.980148, y -25..0, z -3.443522..44.226352; no fillet changes the box.

The design's own order, Fillet2 then Fillet1. Fillet2: the ball takes the riser away and rolls on over the half disc, tangent to it and to the bottom (its centre 11.9 under the bottom, 27.36 from the disc's axis), the start face and the cut face grown down to meet it. It adds the section between the bottom, the riser, the disc and the ball's arc, 18.966272, along the depth, less 6.275778 past the cut: 467.881033. Fillet1 takes (1 - pi/4) 81 off the end face's left edge and 81 (tan(a/2) - a/2) off the cut's vertical edge (a = 63.02 degrees between their faces' normals), each along 29.233: 657.514823 in all. Its rounding of the end face's edge comes within 0.28 of Fillet2's contact on the bottom there (micrometres of material at most): 63045.538897. One valid solid, no note on either fillet. Before, Fillet2's ball kept to the riser's plane continued and hung beside the disc as a sheet.
The other order: Fillet1 moved before Fillet2, Fillet2 adding as before: 63045.538897.
